The Suite Life on Deck Full Episode | Can You Dig It? 🪏 | Disney Channel
Watch the full episode of The Suite Life on Deck, "Can You Dig It?". The group heads to an island to an archaeology dig. Once there, Cody is convinced he can find a treasured, but long-lost crown belonging to Princess Xaria. When Zack accidentally finds the crown, Bailey becomes possessed by the spirit of Princess Xaria. Once she takes Zack prisoner, Cody and the gang follow to return the crown to the princess’ statue and free Bailey from her spirit and Zack from a punishment inflicted by Princess Xaria.

Watch the next The Suite Life on Deck full episode here: https://youtu.be/6rRIF01z-t0

Check out more Suite Life on Deck videos here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBFC1E66D9F766777

Zack (Dylan Sprouse) and Cody (Cole Sprouse)  have signed on for school on the seas aboard the S.S. Tipton in The Suite Life on Deck.  London Tipton (Brenda Song) joins Zack and Cody as they travel the seven seas with Woody (Matthew Timmons), Bailey (Debby Ryan), Marcus (Doc Shaw), and a school of new friends.
